mapper.select:
select count(hd.seq) from hp_disease hd join cm_hospital ch on ch.seq = hd.hospital_seq and ch.is_enabled join cm_disease cd on cd.seq = hd.disease_seq and cd.is_enabled
hd.is_enabled
AND ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')

select hd.seq, ch.seq as hospitalSeq, ch.name as hospitalName, cd.seq as diseaseSeq, cd.name as diseaseName, ( select count(cc.seq) from cm_contents cc join cm_doctor dt on dt.seq = cc.doctor_seq and dt.is_enabled where cc.is_enabled and cc.is_viewed and dt.hospital_seq = ch.seq and cc.disease_seq = cd.seq ) as contentsCount, (select count(*) from hp_disease_treatment where hp_disease_seq = hd.seq and is_enabled) as treatmentCount, to_char(cast(hd.updated_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedAt from hp_disease hd join cm_hospital ch on ch.seq = hd.hospital_seq and ch.is_enabled join cm_disease cd on cd.seq = hd.disease_seq and cd.is_enabled
hd.is_enabled
AND ch.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
ORDER BY hd.seq DESC
LIMIT #{pagination.endNum} OFFSET #{pagination.startNum}

select hd.seq, ch.seq as hospitalSeq, ch.name as hospitalName, cd.seq as diseaseSeq, cd.name as diseaseName, ( select count(cc.seq) from cm_contents cc join cm_doctor dt on dt.seq = cc.doctor_seq and dt.is_enabled where cc.is_enabled and cc.is_viewed and dt.hospital_seq = ch.seq and cc.disease_seq = cd.seq ) as contentsCount, (select count(*) from hp_disease_treatment where hp_disease_seq = hd.seq and is_enabled) as treatmentCount, to_char(cast(hd.updated_at at time zone 'kst' AS timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedAt from hp_disease hd join cm_hospital ch on ch.seq = hd.hospital_seq and ch.is_enabled join cm_disease cd on cd.seq = hd.disease_seq and cd.is_enabled
hd.is_enabled AND hd.seq = #{seq}
